newsitem.title: UK: BOXING-LEWIS TO DEFEND WBC TITLE AGAINST AKINWANDE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-LEWIS TO DEFEND WBC TITLE AGAINST AKINWANDE.

text.p: World Boxing Council (WBC) heavyweight champion Lennox Lewis will defend his title against fellow Briton Henry Akinwande in Atlantic City on July 12.
Akinwande, 31, has relinquished the World Boxing Organisation (WBO) crown for a chance at the WBC title.
Lewis's manager Frank Maloney said on Wednesday his fighter could earn $2.1 million after an agreement was reached with Akinwande's promoter Don King.
Lewis, also 31, regained the WBC title when he defeated American Oliver McCall in a bizarre bout in Las Vegas on February 7.
McCall, who stopped punching during the fight and burst into tears afterwards, was sent to a mental hospital earlier this month after a court order obtained by his wife and mother.
